title: Taiwanese Teas Take Top Prizes at the UK's Leafies Awards
summaryZh: 台灣茶在英國The Leafies大賽奪紅茶組最大獎，共獲7金22銀26銅。
summaryHi: ब्रिटेन की The Leafies चाय प्रतियोगिता में ताइवान की ब्लैक टी ने शीर्ष पुरस्कार जीता; कुल 7 स्वर्ण, 22 रजत और 26 कांस्य पदक।
summaryEs: Tés de Taiwán triunfan en el concurso británico The Leafies: mejor té negro y 7 oros, 22 platas y 26 bronces.
summaryJa: 台湾茶が英国の品評会The Leafiesで紅茶部門の最高賞、金7・銀22・銅26を獲得。
summaryKo: 대만 차가 영국 차 대회 The Leafies에서 홍차 부문 최고상을 받고 금 7, 은 22, 동 26개를 수상했다.
summaryEn: Taiwanese teas won the top black tea prize at the UK's Leafies competition, plus 7 gold, 22 silver and 26 bronze awards.
paragraphs: Taiwanese tea growers have once again impressed international experts, taking several of the top honours at The Leafies, a British tea competition whose results were announced this week.

Founded in 2022 by the UK Tea Academy, the contest aims to promote fine tea and tea culture. Hundreds of entries are judged by professional tasters over several rounds of blind tasting, so the judges do not know where each tea comes from.

The Best of Black Tea award went to Mi Ying Black Tea, produced by Fusensen, a Tainan company that has been operating since 1985. The tea, made from leaves grown in eastern Taiwan, is known for its natural honey aroma.

Meanwhile, the Hsinchu teahouse Riverbank Cat and the Miaoli tea farm Tsengs Tea shared the Best of Retail Teas prize, one for a black tea and the other for an oolong. Overall, Taiwanese teas earned 7 gold, 22 silver and 26 bronze awards.

The result continues a strong run for Taiwan, whose teas also won the black tea title in 2024 and the overall top award in 2025. The competition is organised with the luxury London grocer Fortnum & Mason, which may stock winning teas. The ceremony is planned for January 2027.
Tea from Taiwan won big prizes in the UK this week. The prizes are called The Leafies.
A group called the UK Tea Academy runs the contest. It started in 2022. Hundreds of teas from many countries took part.
The best black tea was from Taiwan. Its name is Mi Ying Black Tea. A company in Tainan makes it. The tea smells a little like honey.
Two small tea shops from Hsinchu and Miaoli also won a prize together. One sells black tea. The other sells oolong tea.
In total, Taiwan won 7 gold, 22 silver and 26 bronze prizes. A famous old shop in London may sell the winning teas. The prize party is in London in January.

比賽從 2022 年開始。

最好的紅茶來自台灣。
它的名字是蜜韻紅茶。
一家台南的公司生產這款茶。
這款茶聞起來有一點像蜂蜜。
來自新竹和苗栗的兩家小茶店也一起得了獎。
一家賣紅茶。
另一家賣烏龍茶。
台灣總共贏得 7 金、22 銀和 26 銅。
倫敦一家有名的老店可能會販售得獎的茶。
頒獎派對將在一月於倫敦舉行。

paragraphs: Taiwanese teas have won some of the top prizes at The Leafies, an international tea competition in the UK. The results were announced this week.
The contest was started in 2022 by the UK Tea Academy to promote good tea and tea culture. Professional judges taste hundreds of teas in several rounds without knowing who made them.
The prize for the best black tea went to Mi Ying Black Tea from Fusensen, a Tainan company founded in 1985. The tea has a honey smell, and its leaves are grown in eastern Taiwan.
Two smaller businesses, the Riverbank Cat teahouse in Hsinchu and the Tsengs Tea farm in Miaoli, shared the prize for the best retail tea. One entered a black tea and the other an oolong.

Altogether, Taiwan collected 7 gold, 22 silver and 26 bronze awards. The contest is run with Fortnum & Mason, a famous London food shop, which may sell the winning teas. The ceremony will take place in London in January 2027.
sentZh: 台灣茶在英國國際茶葉大賽 The Leafies 中贏得多項大獎。

專業評審分幾輪品嚐數百款茶，過程中不知道茶是誰做的。
最佳紅茶獎由福鑫森的蜜韻紅茶獲得，這是一家 1985 年在台南成立的公司。
這款茶帶有蜂蜜香氣，茶葉種植於台灣東部。
兩家較小的業者——新竹的河岸貓茶館和苗栗的曾家茶園——共同獲得最佳零售茶獎。
一家以紅茶參賽，另一家則以烏龍茶參賽。

比賽與倫敦知名食品店福南梅森合辦，該店可能會販售得獎茶。

sentZh: 台灣茶農再次讓國際專家刮目相看，在本週公布結果的英國茶葉大賽 The Leafies 中拿下多項大獎。
這項比賽由英國茶學院於 2022 年創立，旨在推廣優質茶葉與茶文化。
數百件參賽茶品由專業品茶師經過多輪盲品評審，因此評審並不知道每款茶的來源。
「最佳紅茶獎」由福鑫森生產的蜜韻紅茶獲得，這家台南公司自 1985 年經營至今。
這款茶以台灣東部種植的茶葉製成，以天然蜂蜜香氣聞名。
此外，新竹茶館河岸貓與苗栗茶園曾家茶共同獲得「最佳零售茶獎」，分別以紅茶和烏龍茶獲獎。

這項成績延續了台灣的佳績：台灣茶在 2024 年也曾奪得紅茶組冠軍，2025 年更拿下總冠軍。
比賽與倫敦高級食品商福南梅森合辦，該店可能會上架得獎茶品。
頒獎典禮預定於 2027 年 1 月舉行。

paragraphs: Taiwan's tea industry has added to its growing international reputation, with local producers claiming several of the most prestigious awards at The Leafies, a British competition whose results were released this week.

Established in 2022 by the UK Tea Academy to champion fine tea and the culture surrounding it, the contest relies on rigorous blind tasting. Hundreds of entries pass through several rounds of assessment by professional judges, who evaluate each tea without knowing its origin.

The coveted Best of Black Tea title was awarded to Mi Ying Black Tea, made by Fusensen, a Tainan firm founded in 1985. Grown in eastern Taiwan, the leaves produce a tea celebrated for its distinctive honey fragrance.

Smaller producers were also recognised. The Hsinchu teahouse Riverbank Cat and the Miaoli farm Tsengs Tea jointly received the Best of Retail Teas award, for a black tea and an oolong respectively. In all, Taiwanese entries secured 7 gold, 22 silver and 26 bronze medals across black, oolong and white tea.

The achievement builds on earlier successes, including the black tea title in 2024 and the overall Best in Show prize in 2025. Because the awards are run in partnership with Fortnum & Mason, the historic London retailer, winning teas may reach its shelves. The ceremony will be held in London in January 2027.
sentZh: 台灣茶產業的國際聲譽再添一筆，本地業者在本週公布結果的英國大賽 The Leafies 中奪得數項最具聲望的獎項。
這項比賽由英國茶學院於 2022 年設立，旨在推廣優質茶葉及其相關文化，並採用嚴謹的盲品方式。
數百件參賽茶品須經專業評審多輪評估，評審在不知道產地的情況下評分。
眾所矚目的「最佳紅茶」頭銜頒給了福鑫森製作的蜜韻紅茶，該公司是 1985 年成立的台南企業。
茶葉產自台灣東部，泡出的茶以獨特的蜜香著稱。
規模較小的業者也獲得肯定。
新竹茶館河岸貓與苗栗茶園曾家茶共同獲頒「最佳零售茶獎」，分別以紅茶和烏龍茶獲獎。
台灣參賽茶品在紅茶、烏龍茶與白茶類別中總共拿下 7 金、22 銀和 26 銅。
這項成就建立在過去的佳績之上，包括 2024 年的紅茶組冠軍和 2025 年的「全場最佳」大獎。
由於獎項與倫敦老字號零售商福南梅森合辦，得獎茶有機會登上其貨架。
頒獎典禮將於 2027 年 1 月在倫敦舉行。

paragraphs: Taiwanese tea has consolidated its standing on the global stage, with domestic producers sweeping a number of the most prestigious accolades at The Leafies, an international competition based in the United Kingdom whose results were unveiled this week.

Launched in 2022 by the UK Tea Academy with the aim of fostering appreciation for fine tea, the competition is notable for its rigorous methodology. Several hundred submissions undergo multiple rounds of blind tasting, ensuring that professional judges assess each tea purely on its merits rather than its provenance.

The coveted Best of Black Tea accolade went to Mi Ying Black Tea, produced by Fusensen, a Tainan-based enterprise established in 1985. Cultivated in eastern Taiwan, the leaves yield a brew renowned for its distinctive honeyed aroma.

Notably, smaller enterprises also gained recognition. The Hsinchu teahouse Riverbank Cat and the Miaoli estate Tsengs Tea shared the Best of Retail Teas award, for a black tea and an oolong respectively. Overall, Taiwanese entries amassed 7 gold, 22 silver and 26 bronze medals spanning black, oolong and white varieties.

This success extends a remarkable streak that includes the black tea title in 2024 and the overall Best in Show award in 2025. Since the competition is co-organised with Fortnum & Mason, the venerable London grocer, the winning teas could gain lucrative access to discerning British consumers. The awards ceremony is scheduled for January 2027.
sentZh: 台灣茶進一步鞏固了其在國際舞台上的地位，國內業者在本週公布結果的英國國際大賽 The Leafies 中囊括多項最具聲望的殊榮。
這項比賽由英國茶學院於 2022 年發起，旨在提升人們對優質茶的鑑賞，並以嚴謹的評審方法著稱。
數百件參賽作品須經多輪盲品，確保專業評審純粹依據茶的品質、而非產地來評分。
眾人夢寐以求的「最佳紅茶」殊榮由福鑫森生產的蜜韻紅茶奪得，該公司是 1985 年成立、總部位於台南的企業。
茶葉栽種於台灣東部，泡出的茶以獨特的蜜香聞名。
值得一提的是，規模較小的業者也獲得肯定。
新竹茶館河岸貓與苗栗茶園曾家茶共同獲得「最佳零售茶獎」，分別以紅茶和烏龍茶獲獎。
整體而言，台灣參賽茶品在紅茶、烏龍茶與白茶各類別共奪得 7 金、22 銀和 26 銅。
這次成功延續了一連串亮眼紀錄，包括 2024 年的紅茶組冠軍與 2025 年的「全場最佳」大獎。
由於比賽與歷史悠久的倫敦食品商福南梅森合辦，得獎茶有機會打入講究品味的英國消費市場，商機可觀。
頒獎典禮預定於 2027 年 1 月舉行。
